_comment: Copy this file to corpus/sources.json (gitignored) and fill in paths to your local source PDFs. Source PDFs are not tracked in this repo — see .gitignore and docs/product/benchmark-definition.md. Each value is a path to the PDF, resolved relative to the repo root. The literal string "default" means corpus/<slug>/source.pdf (or source.epub for EPUB books). Set a book to null or omit it to skip during regeneration.
